solos.note: The unaccompanied opening cadenza — twelve seconds that reset what a jazz solo could be.
Cherokee's changes at a tempo nobody had taken them before.
The one track on Kind Of Blue where Kelly, not Evans, takes the chair.
Sixteen bars in and already three tonal centres deep.
Recorded eleven days before LaFaro died at twenty-five.
